title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Ten campus places for focused work, group study, creative breaks, exercise, advising, and community connection, verified through current CSULB sources.

cards.title: Match the Library Floor to the Assignment
cards.subtitle: Quiet work, group study, research help, and technology occupy different floors
cards.notes: Use the fourth floor for quiet work; choose the second, third, fifth, first-floor Spidell Center, or lower level when conversation helps.
cards.short_summary: A six-level academic hub where designated zones separate quiet concentration from collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: CSULB designates the University Library's fourth floor for quiet study and the second, third, fifth, first-floor Spidell Technology Center, and lower level for group study.
cards.source_title: Study Areas | California State University Long Beach
cards.access_notes: Consult the University Library's current hours before visiting; individual service desks may keep different schedules.

cards.title: Bring Computer-Heavy Work to the Horn Center
cards.subtitle: An open computer lab, printing stations, technical help, and student study space
cards.notes: Head here when an assignment needs a campus computer, printing, or technical support alongside room to settle in and work.
cards.short_summary: A practical lower-campus work base combining computers, printing, technical assistance, and study seating.
cards.evidence_claim: CSULB states that the Horn Center offers an open computer lab, Technology Help Desk, printing stations, and study space for all CSULB students regardless of major.
cards.source_title: Academic Technology Resources for Students | California State University Long Beach
cards.access_notes: The space is intended for CSULB students; check Academic Technology Services for current building and support hours.

cards.title: Use the Graduate Center for Work and Feedback
cards.subtitle: A second-floor Library home base for graduate study and advising
cards.notes: Bring solo or small-group work, then pair the visit with a writing-support or graduate-advising appointment when useful.
cards.short_summary: A graduate-focused collaborative workspace that places advising and writing support beside study tables.
cards.evidence_claim: The Graduate Center hosts a collaborative graduate study space on the University Library's second floor, along with advising appointments and graduate writing support.
cards.source_title: Graduate Study Space | California State University Long Beach
cards.access_notes: The collaborative study space follows University Library hours; advising and writing support may require appointments.

cards.title: Reset Between Classes at the Japanese Garden
cards.subtitle: A living museum used for contemplation, learning, research, and cultural programs
cards.notes: Reserve before arriving, then use the garden for a quiet reset or check its calendar for workshops, arts events, and seasonal programs.
cards.short_summary: A landscaped campus living museum where wellness, cultural learning, research, and art programming overlap.
cards.evidence_claim: CSULB describes the Japanese Garden as a place for learning, cultural exchange, contemplation, research, creative activity, cultural programming, and wellness.
cards.source_title: Learn at the Garden | California State University Long Beach
cards.access_notes: Reservations are required. CSULB states that admission is free for its students, faculty, and staff; groups need approved reservations.

cards.entity_name: Carolyn Campagna Kleefeld Contemporary Art Museum
cards.title: Turn a Break Into a Gallery Visit
cards.subtitle: Free exhibitions and art-making programs inside the Horn Center building
cards.notes: Check the exhibition calendar, walk through the galleries, or time a visit for a scheduled community night or Second Saturday activity.
cards.short_summary: A free campus museum offering contemporary exhibitions, multidisciplinary projects, and participatory art programs.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum's Spring 2026 announcement states that Kleefeld Contemporary, its events, and its programs are free and open to the public and serve students and campus communities.
cards.source_title: Kleefeld Contemporary Spring 2026 Exhibitions Press Release
cards.access_notes: Gallery schedules change during exhibition installation. Check the museum's visit information before arriving or requesting a group visit.

cards.title: Choose a Movement Break That Fits the Day
cards.subtitle: Courts, an indoor track, climbing, fitness equipment, activity rooms, and aquatics
cards.notes: Bring your Beach ID and choose one manageable activity—track laps, a workout, climbing, a court session, or time in the aquatics area.
cards.short_summary: A student recreation facility that supports everything from short movement breaks to structured fitness activities.
cards.evidence_claim: CSULB lists three-court and multi-activity gyms, an indoor track, fitness equipment, racquetball courts, activity rooms, a climbing wall, wellness center, pool, and spa at the SRWC.
cards.source_title: Student Wellness Resources | California State University Long Beach
cards.access_notes: Access is for CSULB students and eligible associates or affiliates. Verify current entry requirements and activity schedules with the SRWC.

cards.title: Pair a Work Session With Practical Support
cards.subtitle: Computers and printing alongside counseling, guidance, mentoring, and workshops
cards.notes: Use the computer or printing access, then ask staff whether advising, legal support, mentoring, or an upcoming workshop fits your need.
cards.short_summary: A supportive campus center connecting everyday academic tools with immigration-informed student services.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dream Success Center provides computer and printing access, counseling and wellness support, academic and financial-aid guidance, mentoring, workshops, and referrals.
cards.source_title: DSC Services and Resources | California State University Long Beach
cards.access_notes: Located in Student Success Center room 290. Some services, including specified guidance and legal services, require an appointment.

cards.entity_name: Asian, Pacific Islander, & Desi Resource Center
cards.title: Connect Through the APID Campus Hub
cards.subtitle: A cultural and educational center supporting belonging, leadership, and mentorship
cards.notes: Stop by FO4 rooms 276 and 278, ask about current programs, and use the center as a starting point for mentorship or student-organization connections.
cards.short_summary: A student-facing cultural hub built around community support, leadership, storytelling, and educational programming.
cards.evidence_claim: CSULB identifies the APID Resource Center as a cultural and educational campus hub supporting students through affirming programs, leadership, mentorship, and community partnerships.
cards.source_title: Asian, Pacific Islander, & Desi Resource Center | California State University Long Beach
cards.access_notes: Located in FO4 rooms 276 and 278. The listed hours are Monday–Thursday 8 a.m.–7 p.m. and Friday 8 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Find Community at the Black Resource Center
cards.subtitle: A Black-centered campus environment for connection, cultural growth, and programs
cards.notes: Visit FO4 room 274, meet the staff, and check the center's current events or newsletter for programs aligned with its community mission.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated gathering and programming space centered on the cultural development of CSULB's Black community.
cards.evidence_claim: CSULB says the Black Resource Center provides a supportive, functional, Black-centered facility where Black students, staff, and faculty can come together.
cards.source_title: Black Resource Center | California State University Long Beach
cards.access_notes: Located in FO4 room 274. The page lists summer hours of Monday–Thursday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; verify term-specific hours before visiting.

cards.title: Route Several Student Tasks Through One Building
cards.subtitle: A named campus center housing advising, access, transfer, equity, and support programs
cards.notes: Check your program's room before walking over; the building groups multiple student services, but appointments and eligibility differ by office.
cards.short_summary: A multi-program student-support building useful for coordinating advising, access, transfer, and community resources.
cards.evidence_claim: CSULB's current resource guide identifies the Shakarian Student Success Center as home to the Bob Murphy Access Center and multiple student programs and resource centers.
cards.access_notes: Individual offices have separate eligibility, appointment, and operating requirements; confirm the relevant program before visiting.
